description: Land Acquisition - Kennanthudawa, Millaniya D/S Division, Kalutara District - Correction Paper, Payment of Compensation published in the Gaz. Ex. Ordi. No. 1977/259 dated 01.04.1977
reasoning: This gazette content exclusively concerns land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains multiple notices under Section 7 of the Act regarding the acquisition of specific land parcels, descriptions of properties to be acquired, details about claimants, and revisions to inquiry dates for compensation payments. The content focuses entirely on land-related administrative procedures, making it a clear example of Type 4 (Land Gazettes) as it deals with land acquisitions, property descriptions, and compensation processes.
